name: chat
description: The chat loop: `chat` opens or continues a conversation — its prompt from the tree's SOUL.md, each turn kept, the `infer` peer asked, `bash` tool calls run in the shell app's shell (head shell/app; without the shell app a bash call answers exit 127) and `message` tool calls sent as a `chat` to another party — and answers the opener with a `chat` reply. From anyone (another agent's `message`, root): `chat` is open — no role gates it (shruggr/skein#143); root narrows it by a role, a grant or a filter.
